summary.text: Johnny Pennington is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The Democratic primary scheduled for May 19, 2026, was canceled and he advanced to the general election without appearing on the ballot.
He lost the District 24 special election on March 19, 2024, and the November 2024 general election, and ran for District 21 in 2020.
